title: AGENTS.md: the spec artifact gates are said to live in one job, but they run in two Type Check lanes behind the TypeScript Type Check aggregate
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (out-of-scope finding of the developer of PR #33592, card #33572, confirmed by the at-tier contract review 6887829788 on that PR). `reach:` an agent reading AGENTS.md looks for the six spec artifact gates in one job and reads the wrong lane's log.

**What is wrong.** AGENTS.md § "Touched `packages/spec`? Regenerate its artifacts BEFORE pushing" (on `main`, around lines 651 to 653) says all six checked-in generated artifacts' gates "live in one job — `TypeScript Type Check` in `lint.yml`". On `main` they run in two lanes behind that aggregate: `check:api-surface` in `Type Check · consumer gates` (`lint.yml` around 6116) and the other five in `Type Check · source gates` (around 5145 to 5444); `TypeScript Type Check` (around 6465) is the required aggregate over the lanes. The sentence about lanes running every gate is right.

**What lands.** Say the gates run in the `Type Check · source gates` and `Type Check · consumer gates` lanes, behind the required `TypeScript Type Check` aggregate, and name which lane holds `check:api-surface`. PR #33592 already says this in `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`; keep the two consistent. `AGENTS.md` is governed (Tier H); line and byte budgets apply. `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue "TypeScript Type Check" AGENTS.md one job` → none. **New.**
